note: Rewritten from Light 1930, pp. 190—191; original in English; the A and B columns of the original table are two specimens, and no means are given. In 1932 the same author added the alate and the nymph in "Contribution toward a revision of the American species of Amitermes" (pp. 377—383); this entry rests on the 1930 text only.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alate not described. Soldier of the emersoni species group, closest to A. emersoni, differing in the more strongly curved mandibles (mandible curvature index II 0.11), the tooth placed lower, near the middle of the mandible and smaller, and the mandible thicker below the tooth; the head is much less constricted than in A. emersoni, head constriction index about 0.95. Worker close to A. emersoni but with a narrower and longer head, the sides gradually narrowing posteriorly. According to the 1932 revision, the alate and nymph were first described only then.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Body generally white to pale yellow, only the apical two-thirds of the mandibles pale brown. Head broadly oval, sides moderately convex, widest at the middle, posterior corners broadly rounded, narrowing little anteriorly; head relatively low and flat, without the prominence of the fontanelle region seen in A. emersoni. Mandibles more curved than in A. emersoni, the tooth of the left mandible flush with the tooth position, that of the right mandible below the tooth position; tooth small, not projecting, directed along half the axis of the mandible; mandible widest below the tooth (except at the base). Antennae similar to those of A. emersoni. Postmentum wider and flatter than in A. emersoni. Measurements (mm; the two soldiers A and B): head length 1.14; maximum head width 0.92; minimum head width 0.87; mandible length 0.92 (A), 0.89 (B); postmentum length 0.58; maximum postmentum width 0.34; minimum postmentum width 0.33; pronotum width 0.61 (A), 0.63 (B); head index 0.81 (A), 0.83 (B); head constriction index 0.95 (A), 0.94 (B); head-mandible index 0.81 (A), 0.79 (B); postmentum constriction index 0.97 (A).

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Close to A. emersoni, but the head is narrower and longer, the sides gradually narrowing posteriorly; mandibles as in plate 14, fig. 8 of the original. Measurements (mm; the two workers A and B): head length 0.73 (A), 0.76 (B); head width 0.83 (A), 0.94 (B); pronotum width 0.46 (A), 0.56 (B).

sections.label: Nymph
sections.text: Measurements of a last-instar reproductive nymph (mm): head length (including the labrum) 1.09; maximum head width 0.86; pronotum width 0.76; total length 5.35; mesothoracic wing pad length 1.01.
